name: mona-expert
description: mona-agent — the open-source AI agent for your computer. A secure, sandboxed app that runs quietly in the background on macOS, Linux and WSL2, so you can control your machine from anywhere: run commands, manage files, automate tasks, stream live metrics. Private by design with an AES-256 key vault and egress-only networking.
